mathematical_meanings: Left image: The dot highlights a particular maximum on the continuing function curve. Right image: The dot includes the left endpoint (−5, 2) in the function graph.
Rationales: The feature identifies a specific point on the interior of the continuing graph in the left image and marks an endpoint included in the plotted branch in the right image. The orange point labeled (1.2, 5.5) at the curve’s peak. The filled cyan point at (−5, 2), where the curve ends on the left.
